statement: A refused frame is retried at a fresh proof nonce: the retry's slot is above every slot its proposer signed and above the floor the refusal names, never a second different proof at one nonce, because the peer holds the proposer's signature on the refused attempt's proof. The contract takes any nonce above the stored one (start nonce > stored, counter nonce >= the opening nonce, finalize by a newer signed proof), so a gap costs nothing; a nonce not below the JS-safe ceiling has no digest.
